rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Its permission dialog names the tool and the resolved path, so the gate reads it and approves a read inside this fleet's own roots; any other dialog, and any secrets path, is carded instead. A plain Enter submits. Its composer is a heavy left bar with no border, which the shared shape reader recognises without a harness name. The first Escape is swallowed by a queued-input state and the second cancels, so the key is sent twice. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. While a turn runs the pane carries `esc to interrupt` with a rotating spinner word and an elapsed cell; idle it carries no elapsed cell. Busy is read from the lifecycle hooks, never from that footer.
